beats.text: My monologue has the word cut in it.

lines.text: Cut in a line? Rolls on.

beats.line: For when everyone else has gone home.

source.app: Ghost Light Tape room, real app as a web page (ghostlight-web/serve.sh), demo account; flow flows/tape-cut-in-the-line.json; camera fed real stock footage through FAKE_CAM (Chromium fake capture). A take cannot roll in a browser (no native recorder), so the app shows the room ready and the 3 2 1 countdown.
source.how_it_works: app/tape/[id].tsx and src/rehearsal/tape-cues.ts on ghostlight main: action rolls, cut stops, again redoes, keeper stars; a cut inside the script is a line, not a cue.

monologue.author: William Shakespeare
monologue.cut_line: my buckler cut through and through

source.sql: select m.id, m.character_name, p.title from monologues m join plays p on p.id=m.play_id where lower(m.text) ~ '\mcut\M' and p.author in (...)
